title: peranema aspidioides
intro: Peranema aspidioides, commonly known as Aspidium aspidioides or Peranema aspidioides, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various parts of the world for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, showcasing its potential in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Peranema aspidioides include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms associated with fever, cough, and cold. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
